facts.fact: 男主在日记里写：规律作息、新鲜空气、好食物、锻炼就是他需要的全部
facts.anchor: It’s all I needed. A healthy routine. Fresh air, good food and exercise.

facts.fact: 他感觉更好、更健康、更年轻；没有噩梦、没有恐惧
facts.anchor: I feel so much better now: better, fitter, younger. No more nightmares. No more fears.

facts.fact: 他把网球、咖啡杯、夜间电话归因为神经紧张，在近期事件面前可以理解
facts.anchor: Nothing but nerves, he told himself. Wholly understandable, in the face of recent events.

facts.fact: 他承认 Caroline 是他孩子的母亲
facts.anchor: She was, after all, the mother of his children.

facts.fact: 他发现自己摆两杯茶，像过去总做的那样
facts.anchor: Found himself setting out two cups for tea, just as he’d always done in the past.

facts.fact: 他拿出她的香水喷在枕头旁，在电线声与雪松木、八角、海盐、玫瑰精油的气味中入睡
facts.anchor: he took a bottle of her scent from its place in the wardrobe and sprayed the pillow next to his, and fell asleep to the sound of the wires, and the soft caress of cedarwood, and star anise, and sea salt, and otto of roses.

facts.fact: 凌晨 2:30 他被电话铃吵醒
facts.anchor: He awoke at two-thirty that morning to the ringing of the telephone.

facts.fact: 线上有噼啪声，却听起来足够真实，也许线路重新接通了
facts.anchor: There came a crackling sound on the line. And yet it sounded live enough; perhaps it had been reconnected.

facts.fact: 白噪音中的女人声音喊「Arthur，求你。Arthur，让我进去—」
facts.anchor: Arthur, please. Arthur, let me in—

facts.fact: 听筒里传来第二阵恶毒的静电嘶嘶声，伴随蓝光一闪
facts.anchor: There came a second vicious hiss of static from the earpiece, accompanied by a flare of blue light.

facts.fact: 静电中有个声音尖叫：Arthur！让我进去！求你！
facts.anchor: a voice in the static that screamed: Arthur! Let me in! Please!

facts.fact: 他尖叫、跑进走廊、用拳头砸门、喊「滚开！滚开！」
facts.anchor: He screamed, a wordless, animal sound, and ran into the hallway, and beat his fists against the door, and cried out: ‘Go away! Go away! ’

facts.fact: 声音骤停，一切又归于寂静
facts.anchor: The sounds cut off abruptly, and everything was silent again.

facts.fact: 结尾他想起 Arthur 写的「Caroline 在电线里」，问她现在在哪儿、什么可怕事件被印刻在电线杆下
facts.anchor: Caroline is in the wires, Arthur had written. Where was she now? And what dreadful event had somehow been imprinted here, under the pylon?
